w: Swamishri arrived at Entebbe International Airport at 10.57 am. In the afternoon a beautiful procession of the new murtis was carried out on the streets of Kampala. The Indian Ambassador for Uganda, H.E. B.S. Prakash, welcomed Swamishri during the evening assembly.
ph: In a jovial mood with the local folk dancers, Sep 26 1999

w: At 10.50 am, Swamishri sanctified the 'BAPS Herbal Care Center' in the precincts of Amdavad Mandir. Swamishri was informed about the manufacturing of ayurvedic medicines by the Sanstha. Thereafter, Swamishri visited 'Pramukh Swami Health Care and Research Center' and inaugurated the color sonography machine. Swamishri also sanctified 'Pramukh Swami Institute of Information Technology' (PIIT) where students are taught computer courses.

Various dignitaries and leaders of different communities came to offer their condolences to Swamishri for the attack in Akshardham. The Defence Minister of India, Shri George Fernandes, arrived to offer his condolences.
Vyomesh Joshi, a devotee and Executive Vice President of a large computer firm, came with his colleague, Frank, for Swamishri's darshan.
Frank asked Swamishri, "What should we do to solve our Company's problems and how can we progress further?"

Swamishri replied, "If everyone has moral and spiritual values then they can work with each other. You have all the required facilities but if there is spirituality then you will have mutual friendship. If however this is lacking then the person will work only for money or for the sake of his job. Whereas out of spirituality, he will do it honestly and with integrity. He will feel that he cannot do any wrong and that he has to do his duty responsibly. So with this principle the company will run better. It will be of benefit to others and to oneself. That is why India teaches the need for spiritual values. One should have feelings that this is my Company and I wish to strive for its progress." Then Vyomesh Joshi asked Frank if he had any other questions. Frank nodded with a no. Swamishri responded, "The answer to his one question provides the solution to all questions. On the single point of spirituality all other issues can be resolved. When a person works honestly, believes all the employees as his own people and works with unity and friendship, then he will have true progress. This is what is lacking in our country and the world."
If we find a master key like a true Sadhu, then all our locks of innumerable births will be opened and we'll experience happiness. (21-9-2003, Sarangpur).
We have Maharaj, Satpurush and Satsang; therefore look after them like we look after a precious diamond by placing it in a safe. (21-9-203, Sarangpur).
One does not find fault in others
One does not hate anyone
One does not falter or fail in understanding God's form
One does not lapse in understanding the Satpurush. (21-9-2003, Sarangpur)
When one feels like leaving the (refuge of) Satpurush to go elsewhere, it tantamounts to not having looked after one's' satsang. (21-9-2003, Sarangpur)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
23 September 2003, Sarangpur
Thirty-five women devotees and fifteen kishores pilgrimaged by foot from Tajpur.

Murti-Pratishtha Over 1800 devotees had darshan of Swamishri perform the traditional Vedic murti-pratishta ceremony of the murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha-Krishna Dev and the Guru Parampara. Then, after performing the murti-pratishtha arti and having darshan, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Through the mandir, we have to strengthen satsang in our lives. So make use of this mandir. Sincerely observe the niyams Maharaj has given, and understand and consolidate the philosophy He has given to us.” Swamishri then performed the pujan of the new murtis for the mandirs in Jinja, Tororo, Mwanza and Mombasa.
Miscellaneous

ds.t: "They are the ones who do it"
w: Janmangal Swami said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "At this age, how much activity you carry on! So much is going on outside, and you calmly direct it all while sitting in your room."

Swamishri said, "What Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have done has to be looked after properly, doesn't it! They are still doing the same work. They are the ones doing it, and it is their presence within."
Janmangal Swami said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj did only a little. You have increased it so much!"

Swamishri said, "You cannot say at all that they did only a little. Everything happens through them alone, they are the ones who do it. Even if lifetime after lifetime passes, we cannot do as much as they did. What a great thing that is!"
Krishnavallabh Swami said, "It is right that they did it, but now they do it by residing in you, don't they?"
Janmangal Swami said, "Without you, no one's little pipe would play." (Without you, no one could get anything done.)
Swamishri said, "Others have become ready and are doing good seva."

Janmangal Swami said, "The patience is yours. Everything is contained within you. If someone else had built Akshardham, he would have stayed up in the air, on edge, and would have had to be brought down. But you have so much trust in whoever you entrust things to! Never any worry at all."

Swamishri said, "The one by whose wish it happened, the one who built it, he himself does the worrying and he himself looks after it. Why should we worry? His presence has come in, and see, there are now 800 sadhus, and it did not even take long to reach 800."
"We had gone to a mandir of an outside organisation. Doctor Swami asked the mahant of that mandir, 'How many sadhus are there?'
'Seven.'

'Then increase the number of sadhus!' When Doctor Swami said this, the mahant said, 'We cannot increase the sadhus at all. If the sadhus form a union, there will be trouble. We cannot make more at all.'
He worries about just this many, and you have made 800."
Swamishri said, "It is Yogi Bapa's wish, so he makes them and he himself looks after them."
Janmangal Swami said, "Do a miracle so that you become young. Now that the organisation is well established, how wonderful it would be if you became a little young!"
Pointing to the sadhus sitting in front of him, Swamishri said, "Have all of these become young or not? There are 800 now. Yogiji Maharaj made them, and now he runs it."
Janmangal Swami said, "At this age, how much activity you do! So much is going on outside, and you calmly direct it all sitting in your room."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have done it, so we have to take proper care of it, don't we! They are still doing the work. They are the ones doing it, and it is their presence too."
Janmangal Swami said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj did only a little. You have made it grow so much!"

Swamishri said, "One cannot say at all that they did only a little. Everything happens through them alone, they are the ones who do it. Even if lifetime after lifetime goes by, we cannot do as much as they did. How great that is!"
Krishnavallabh Swami said, "It is right that they did it, but now they are doing it by dwelling in you, aren't they?"
Janmangal Swami said, "Without you, no one's little flute can play."
Swamishri said, "Others have become ready and are doing good seva."

Janmangal Swami said, "The patience is yours. Everything fits into your stomach. If someone else had built Akshardham, he would be up in the air all the time and would have to be brought down, but you have such trust in those to whom you entrusted it! Never any worry at all."

Swamishri said, "The one by whose wish it was done, the one who built it, he himself worries and he himself takes care of it. What do we have to worry about? His presence has come in, and look, there are 800 sants now, and it did not even take long to have 800."
"We had gone to a mandir of an outside organisation. Doctor Swami asked the mahant of that mandir, 'How many sadhus are there?'
'Seven.'
'Then increase the number of sadhus!' When Doctor Swami said this, the mahant said, 'We cannot increase the sadhus at all. If the sadhus form a union, there will be trouble, so we cannot make more.'
He worries over this much, and you have made 800."
Swamishri said, "It is Yogi Bapa's wish, so he makes them and he himself looks after them."
Janmangal Swami said, "Do such a miracle that you become young. Now that the organisation is well established, how much fun it would be if you became a little young!"
Pointing to the sants sitting in front of him, Swamishri said, "Have all of them become young or not? There are 800 of them. Yogiji Maharaj made them and now he is running it."

Today during the meetings, a devotee brought his small child to Mahant Swami Maharaj for vartman (the initiation vows). A sadhu handling this ritual, in a hurry, placed the water in the child's left hand. Swamishri at once said, "Give it in the right hand."

Seeing this care and precision of Swamishri's, everyone was stunned. On this occasion everyone especially understood with how much love and depth Swamishri, who meets hundreds of visitors every day, meets each individual.

Mahant Swami Maharaj, on the pradakshina (circumambulation) path upstairs in the mandir, had darshan of the gurus and was having darshan near the murti of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. At that time, Aksharvatsaldas Swami pointed to a spot in the pradakshina directly behind the central shrine and said, "If you stand there, there is darshan of all five gurus together."
He was saying this in the sense that the thrones of two gurus each would be on either side of Swamishri.
Swamishri immediately came to the exact middle of the pradakshina and began to have darshan of the gurus, but since he could see only four gurus, he expressed surprise.
Aksharvatsaldas Swami, gesturing for him to face the opposite direction, said, "If you stand like this, we get darshan of five gurus together, including you."
Swamishri laughed and said, "Five gurus means understanding it as Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj... and so on."
Everyone began to laugh.
For Swamishri, who always behaves as a servant, it is impossible even to imagine himself as a guru!

After his puja, before giving his blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj went to take his medicine. At that time he told Atmaswarupdas Swami, "Today the names of those who had done (financial) seva were announced, but nobody stood up. So have it announced again."
To take note of the seva of those who serve and to bless them with his gaze is, in Swamishri's mind, itself a seva.
After waking, Mahant Swami Maharaj wrote some letters. Meanwhile a phone call came from Brahmachintandas Swami. He said:

"Two days ago an assembly of sadhus was held at Yagnapurush Vadi in the presence of the senior sadhus. In it, the senior sadhus gave written answers to the question, 'What do you expect from the sadhus, parshads (lay renunciants) and sadhaks (aspirants) of Sarangpur?' So please write something too."
Swamishri wrote: "Each one should keep divyabhav (a sense of divinity) towards everyone."
Shrutipriyadas Swami suggested, "Shall we write it as 'one ought to keep' instead of 'should keep'?" He was about to correct it with whitener. Swamishri said, "No... it is a command."
Mahant Swami Maharaj finished his meal. A child named Nilkanth Kara told of a dream darshan he had had 3 days before Swamishri's birthday:

"In my dream, Shriji Maharaj took me to Akshardham. It looked like Delhi Akshardham, but it was amid white clouds. I asked Shriji Maharaj, 'Where are Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj?'
'They are preparing to celebrate the birthday (of Mahant Swami Maharaj),' Shriji Maharaj said.
Then I asked, 'What is the purpose of my life?' Before Shriji Maharaj could answer, my mummy woke me up..."
Everyone burst out laughing. At the sadhus' suggestion, he asked Swamishri himself this last question from the dream. Swamishri answered, "To attain God."
By supplying what was left unsaid in the dream, Swamishri completed the unfinished dream.
Where else but in Satsang can one find such a facility!

st.t: Swaminarayan Akshardham Offers a ‘Lesson of Widsom and Peace,’ Says French Senate Delegation Leader After New Delhi Visit
w: Parliamentary Delegation from the Senate of France visits Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. French Senator Mr. Yvon Collin, President of the India-France Friendship Group of the Senate, at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. French Senator, Mr. Hervé Maurey, President of the Senate Standing Committee for Urban Planning and Sustainable Development, at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. French Senator Mrs. Vivetta Lopez, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Culture, Education and Communication, at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. French Senator Mr. Jean-Luc Fichet, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Constitutional Laws and Legislation, at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. Mr. Yvon Collin is welcomed to Swaminarayan Akshardham in a traditional manner by tying a kalva (sacred thread) by Sadhu Gnanmunidas Mr. Hervé Maurey is welcomed to Swaminarayan Akshardham in a traditional manner by applying tilaka (vermillion powder). Mrs. Vivetta Lopez is welcomed to Swaminarayan Akshardham in a traditional manner by offering a garland of flowers. Mr. Jean-Luc Fichet is welcomed to Swaminarayan Akshardham in a traditional manner by tying a kalva (sacred thread). Mr. Yvon Collin performs abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni at Swaminarayan Akshardham. Mr. Hervé Maurey performs abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni at Swaminarayan Akshardham. Mrs. Vivetta Lopez performs abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni at Swaminarayan Akshardham. Mr. Jean-Luc Fichet performs abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni at Swaminarayan Akshardham. Parliamentary Delegation from the Senate of France offers sentiments of peace and harmony at Swaminarayan Akshardham.
A four-member Parliamentary Delegation from the Senate of France experienced the beauty, culture and values of Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi.

Led by President of the India-France Friendship Group of the Senate, Mr. Yvon Collin, the French delegation included Mr. Hervé Maurey, President of the Senate Standing Committee for Urban Planning and Sustainable Development; Mrs. Vivetta Lopez, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Culture, Education and Communication and Mr. Jean-Luc Fichet, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Constitutional Laws and Legislation.

On behalf of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the Spiritual Head of Swaminarayan Akshardham and the BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha, senior sadhus and trustees traditionally welcomed the French delegation by offering a garland of flowers, applying tilaka (vermillion powder) and tying the kalava (sacred thread) on their wrists.

The French Senators offered their respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and admired the Mandir’s art and architecture. They viewed the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) that includes 148 lifelike carved stone elephants depicting messages of social harmony, peace, and spirituality.

Sharing sentiments for world peace and harmony, the French Senate Delegation by offered abhishek, the ceremonial pouring of sanctified water from 151 holy rivers, lakes and ponds across India on the sacred image of Shri Neelkanth Varni. Thereafter, the French Senators experienced the educational exhibition Sanskruti Vihar – a cultural voyage that sails through 10,000 years of India’s glorious heritage, highlighting India’s contributions to humanity through the ages.
Sharing their sentiments at Akshardham, the French Senators wrote:

“The Delegation from the French Senate has just visited the temple created by Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj. We have been delighted by the visit and we hope that all those who visit this temple learn from it a lesson of wisdom and peace. Congratulations. Excellent Work!”
Mr. Yvon Collin, President of the India-France Friendship Group of the Senate
“Very happy to have visited this extraordinary place of worship.”
Mr. Hervé Maurey, President of the Senate Standing Committee for Urban Planning and Sustainable Development

“Congratulations! We are speechless seeing such beauty. Let peace be in the world and in this extraordinary site. Thank You.” Mrs. Vivetta Lopez, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Culture, Education and Communication
“Thank you for this fascinating presentation of this Hindu temple, which makes us feel the power of this religion. Splendid Temple. An Art Piece.”
Mr. Jean-Luc Fichet, Member of the Senate Standing Committee for Constitutional Laws and Legislation

You may know that Swamishri has been in Europe and the UK through September and October of this year. In Paris, he inaugurated a new mandir, attended a parade, and visited the Eiffel Tower. And in London, he celebrated events like Bal Din, Shishu Din, and the Amrut Cup. Were you able to witness any of the events either in person or online?

Yes, I have witnessed a few moments with Bapa in London and Paris, such as: 1) Bapa’s Janma Jayanti in Paris and 2) the London Swagat Sabha. I held up a picture of Tapomurti Neelkanth Varni. I also went to my first Tapomurti pratishtha. The moments that I witnessed made me quite happy. Jay (7) Twinsburg, OH, United States

I loved the Bal-Balika Din! The theme was “Swami by My Side.” Bapa brought our daily routine to life through a wonderful musical. I was in the audience and thoroughly enjoyed every moment! Ananti Naik (8) London, London, United Kingdom

I did not witness the event live, but I attended it online. It was wonderful and also mind-blowing, too! I loved the celebration in front of the Eiffel Tower as it was colourful, and also showed our Indian culture with pride. Every citizen from France who saw the celebration could learn about Bharatiya Sanskriti. I am very grateful to be a devotee of such a wonderful fellowship. Hetvi Vala (11) Rajkot, Gujarat, INDIA

The part when Swamishri inaugurated the Paris mandir was so special. That’s because Bapa made the words of Gunatitanad Swami come true (“Pandade pandade satsang thashe.”) Also, I remember when Swamishri was wearing glasses, he looked stunning, and the tej of Aksharbrahma was appearing. I felt like Maharaj and Swami are in him 100%, and they were attending the special event through him. Whenever I close my eyes, the same murti always appears. Rutva Sindha (13) Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India

I remember the absolutely amazing labh in London and Paris. In Paris, I was lucky to take part in the Nagar Yatra, Murti Pratishtha and Yagna. Plus also I got to stay an extra week to have puja and sabha labh, too. In London, I attended Bal-Balika Din, Swagat Din, Tapomurti Nilkanth Varni Murti Pratishtha, the amazing Janma Jayanti in Wembley, and the Abhar Din. With Bapa being 93 years old, I didn’t think I would be lucky enough to get so many personal memories with him, but he blessed me with some amazing smruti. Thank you so much, Bapa Drashti Dusara (8) Leicester, Leicestershire, United Kingdom
I remember the Bal Din and how I was one of the lucky people who got to say shloks when Swamishri was coming into the hall. Arav (11) Leeds, West Yorkshire, England

I watched online as my guru travelled to Paris and performed pratishtha on all the murtis there. He held a mirror to each murti, and with a special red stick, he placed prana (life force) inside them. Even at an old age, he journeys across the world for his haribhaktas and to fulfil his own guru’s wishes, and he shares labh with everyone in Paris and far beyond. In London, too, he brought joy to the children by filling the celebrations with fun festivals just for them. I would like to make my guru raji by following his agna to complete my Satsang Diksha shloks. Param Piyush Patel (7) Brampton, ON, CANADA

I remember the Bal Din. It was very fun and engaging. I liked the puppet show the most, and the atmosphere was very beautiful. I really enjoyed the whole month when Swami Bapa came to Europe and the UK, and I was also able to see all the events that happened during this time. This was all my online experience. Aarsh Chauhan (13) Abu Dhabi, UAE

Jay Swaminarayan. On 26 September 2026 (Saturday), Bal Din celebrated in the presence of Swamishri. My favourite part was when a presenter asked a question, “Is Akshar Brahma present?” Then Swami put his hand up! Aarya Bhoova (10) Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom

I was pleased to have Bapa’s incredible darshan especially in Bal-Balika Din when Bapa brushed our teeth. It was just like the tears just came out of my eyes automatically. I also really enjoyed the Vidvan Sanman Mahotsav. I was at the front of the line, and for a minute straight Bapa was giving all the children drashti. It was like nothing could disturb me. Thank you to Bapa for giving us unforgettable darshan for 49 days. Jay Swaminarayan Sanvi Khakhkhar (11) Newcastle, Northumberland, United Kingdom

My favorite event was the Jal Yatra. Sadly, I couldn’t go in person. But I got to watch it online. The part I remember was the boat with Mahant Swami Maharaj’s murti on it. It was so neat seeing Maharaj and Swami go down the river in Paris. I also remember that there were a lot of people on the boats. The sad part is that there weren’t a lot of videos on the Jal Yatra, but I searched a lot and watched all the videos I could find. Arohi Patel (11) Eden Prairie, MN, United States
